decision: VAD pauses one response through the mandatory streamer contract; attributed segment-complete STT decides flush or continue
state_machine: idle -> pausing on VAD start overlapping current local playout
pausing -> pending after response-scoped output acknowledgment
pending -> flushed on meaningful final, ambiguity, failure, overflow or timeout
pending -> continued only on an English filler-only segment-complete final or short transcriptless segment
all stale response, epoch, segment, overlap and revision inputs -> ignored

output_contract.pause_ack: No later frame for the target response can enter the local sink; all unsent local audio remains ordered and retained
output_contract.resume: Continue the same response from the retained remainder exactly once
output_contract.stop: Discard only the target response and reject its late audio, completion and resume
output_contract.outside_guarantee: Audio already admitted to the operating system or remote transport
output_contract.non_audio: Return a successful not_active receipt without changing conversation state

transcript_contract.candidate_owner: VAD only; STT-first packets are bounded pre-candidate evidence
transcript_contract.verdict_source: Attributed segment-complete final only; interim text cannot stop or resume
transcript_contract.positive: At least one non-filler word after min_duration commits stop
transcript_contract.negative: English filler-only complete final commits resume
transcript_contract.transcriptless: Below min_duration resumes; at or above min_duration stops
transcript_contract.language: Unknown or unsupported language cannot produce a text backchannel verdict; nonblank final stops
transcript_contract.confidence: Preserved for diagnostics and intentionally excluded from cross-provider policy
transcript_contract.finalization: VAD end is submitted to STT after all segment audio while EOS remains gated

bounds.overflow: Stop and replay through the committed context, including the event that crossed the bound

required_tests: Pause acknowledgment prevents later local sink admission for the target response
Resume preserves exact retained frame order and occurs once
Stop discards only the target response and rejects stale audio, end and resume
Interim filler followed by meaningful final stops
VAD end before final waits for segment completion
Empty, malformed, unsupported-language, timeout and overflow cases stop
Short transcriptless overlap resumes and eligible transcriptless overlap stops
EOS receives no pending overlap evidence
Held STT replays once to the committed context and never a newer turn
Pause does not rotate context or invalidate model work
Confirmed stop performs targeted lifecycle and model invalidation
Protected greeting and legacy VAD behavior remain unchanged
Telephony and unsupported STT selections cannot enable transcript mode
rollback: Disable transcript mode for new sessions. Resolve every already paused session to stop, resume or close before changing its mode. Retain targeted stale-result fences.
